name: Handheld '89
description: A chunky 1989-era monochrome handheld console rendered in the classic 4-shade green LCD palette. Its screen is the face: a blinking cursor at rest, bouncing equalizer bars while recording, marching dots while thinking, a sparkle-checked screen on success and a static-buzz X on error.
author: WhisperHUD

idle.description: Sleepy LCD with a slow-blinking terminal cursor

recording.description: Bouncing equalizer bars on the LCD with a REC dot

processing.description: Marching dots and a tiny spinner while thinking

success.description: Checkmark draws on with a sparkle flourish (holds a clean check)

error.description: Static burst and screen-shake resolving to a clear X
